warnings: Supplier name mapped to entity.legal_name is an assumption: source does not establish it as registered legal name; confidence 0.5 is below the 0.8 threshold so it will be excluded unless reviewed.
Each row carries one supplier; no multi-supplier records observed, but compound names/ABNs should be checked before ingest.
Supplier address lacks a structured state/postcode in some rows (e.g. 'L8, 127 Creek Street, Brisbane QLD' has no postcode); mapped only to address.full with no derived state or postcode.
observed_at_field is null: the only time is resource_last_modified_proxy, which is a publication proxy, not a verified statement time.
Supplier ABN checksum validation is applied; invalid checksums will be rejected. ACN is not inferred from ABN.
Source suppliers in sample are repeated across rows (same ABN for multiple contracts); observations should be deduplicated by source_record_id, not treated as distinct entities.
Address field has no mapping to country; default AU is not applied at ingest.
Licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 per source metadata, but licence_warning is false; no action needed beyond recording it.
